2272215: I and the Village is a 1911 oil-on-canvas painting by the Russian-French artist Marc Chagall created in 1911. It is exhibited at the Museum of Modern Art, New York.
3580243: The church of Notre-Dame de Toute Grâce du Plateau d'Assy is a Roman Catholic church in France, constructed on the plateau d'Assy between 1937 and 1946. It faces Mont Blanc, and is within the territory of the commune of Passy, in the Haute-Savoie department.
Église Notre-Dame de Toute Grâce du Plateau d'Assy
3630757: Self-Portrait with Seven Fingers is a 1913 oil painting by Belarusian-French painter Marc Chagall, painted in 1913 in France. This oil on canvas is a self-portrait in which the artist represents himself painting a reduced version of Of Russia, of Donkeys and Others, with seven fingers on one hand.
3637719: Bella with White Collar is a painting done by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall in 1917. It is a portrait of Bella Rosenfeld Chagall, Chagall's wife at the time.
3698207: The White Crucifixion is a painting by Marc Chagall depicting the Crucifixion of Jesus. It was painted in 1938 and is now in the permanent collection of the Art Institute of Chicago.
3795165: The Painter and His Fiancée is an oil on canvas painting by Marc Chagall, from 1980. It is held since 1990 in the Pushkin Museum, in Moscow.
3795178: The Poet Reclining is a painting by Marc Chagall, painted in oils in 1915. It is owned by Tate Modern, in London.
3796270: Green Violinist is a 1923–24 painting by artist Marc Chagall that is now in the permanent collection of the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum in New York City.
3820975: La Mariée is a gouache and pastel painting by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall, from 1950. It is held in a private collection in Japan.
3878956: Nocturne is an oil on canvas painting by Marc Chagall, created in 1947. It depicts a nocturne scene on a city, in the magical realism style of the artist, with some animals visible.
3964106: The Summer Night's Dream or The Dream on a Summer's Night is a 1939 oil on canvas painting by Marc Chagall, showing a young woman in a wedding dress and a man with a goat's head. It is in the Museum of Grenoble, to which it was given by the artist in 1951.
4780090: Apocalypse in Lilac, Capriccio is a gouache painting by the Russian-born artist Marc Chagall, from 1945. The 51 by 35.5 cm work was created by Chagall in response to the devastation brought by the Holocaust.
5475476: Four Seasons is a 1974 mosaic by Marc Chagall that is located in Chase Tower Plaza in the Loop district of Chicago, Illinois.
16845245: Bouquet with Flying Lovers is an oil on canvas painting by Belarusian-French painter Marc Chagall, from 1963. It is held at the Tate Modern.
17020193: Soleil dans le ciel de Saint-Paul is an in oil on canvas painting by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall, from 1983. It is held in a private collection.
Soleil dans le ciel de Saint-Paul
17031577: The Yellow Crucifixion is a painting by Marc Chagall. It was painted in 1943 and is on display at Musée National d'Art Moderne in Paris, France.
20708206: Bouquet près de la fenêtre is an oil on canvas painting by Marc Chagall, from 1959–1960. Franz Meyer, Chagall's biographer, called it one of Chagall's finest flower paintings.
58018175: America Windows is a 1977 set of stained glass window panels by Marc Chagall that is located at the Art Institute of Chicago in the Loop community area of Chicago, Illinois, United States.
105806412: Le Grand Cirque is an oil and gouache on canvas painting by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall created in 1956. it is held in a private collection.
105883346: Le Grand Cirque is an oil on canvas painting by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall, from 1968. It is held in a private collection.
105952627: Scène de Cirque is an oil on canvas painting by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall, from c. 1970. It is held in a private collection.
106074594: Le Clown au Cirque is a tempera and pen-and-ink painting on board created by Belarusian-French artist Marc Chagall, in 1980. It is held in a private collection.
123243814: The Sources of Music and The Triumph of Music are two murals that Marc Chagall painted in 1966 for the Metropolitan Opera House at the Lincoln Center in New York City.
The Sources of Music and The Triumph of Music
